### 2026-10-13 – So I've just completed the initial head sculpt, genuinely surprised how I managed to get so far without watching any tutorials. Just like a bunch of sketching, extruding, drafting, beveling ahhhhhh. D

**2.4h**

So I've just completed the initial head sculpt, genuinely surprised how I managed to get so far without watching any tutorials. Just like a bunch of sketching, extruding, drafting, beveling ahhhhhh. Definitely a bit more frustrating at times than blender but.. also much more convenient in others due to it's parametric nature. Loving to see him come to life slowly, though I think I might have modelled the head a bit too wide 🙏😭✌️

### 2026-10-14 – Alrighhtttt so this has been a fruitful session. I've done a lot of work. I've made the eyes, rebuilt the side circles  lol, reworked the mask. Tons and tons of chamfering. But again I learnt new stuf

**4h**

Alrighhtttt so this has been a fruitful session. I've done a lot of work. I've made the eyes, rebuilt the side circles  lol, reworked the mask. Tons and tons of chamfering. But again I learnt new stuff, like revolve tool; that helped in making the top of the helmet, and I also learnt slicing the model and in plane sketching. Overall I'm mostly done with the head!! Just the side antennas and back grill left; along with the grills to the side plate of the mask and some other minor detailing. Loving how it's coming out!
